name: Nora
source:
"An inventor who has dedicated herself to her work. She travels the country, selling her creations."

Nora is a cheerful traveling inventor and saleswoman. Though there are hints that she is technically a brilliant inventor, it seems she is not good at understanding what kinds of inventions are marketable or not, or good at understanding people in general.
